rights.title: Rights for “{name}”
rights.hint: Allow runs at once. Ask holds the call until you allow the request. Deny hides the tool; the program does not see it.

reasons.level: Above the level of this access.
reasons.extra: Needs an extra this access does not have.

requests.title: Waiting requests
requests.hint: What a program wants to do with a tool set to “Ask”. Allow runs exactly that.

request.title: Request from “{program}”
request.exactly: Exactly this is run. The program cannot change the request any more, only ask a new one.
request.dangerousText: This request is dangerous: what it does may not be undone. Allow asks once more.
request.confirmText: {program} runs this at once, with exactly these details.

consent.title: {program} wants to use {app}
consent.unverified: The program gives itself this name; {app} has not checked it. Allow only if you started this sign-in yourself.
consent.aiOff: The operator does not let your account use AI. You can only decline this sign-in.
consent.after: The program then stands under My account › Connections › AI tools (MCP), with rights per tool. You can disconnect it there at any time.
consent.broken: The address lacks details. Start connecting again in the program.

operator.programsHint: An AI tool connects with a member's consent in the browser. Off: no new program connects; connected ones keep working.
operator.maxLevelHint: No access may do more, not even one that exists already.
operator.blockedHint: No program sees a blocked tool, whatever a member allows.

errors.right_invalid: There is no such right here.
errors.tool_unknown: There is no such tool here.
errors.level_invalid: There is no such level here.
errors.request_changed: The request was changed after it was asked. It does not run.
errors.confirm_needed: This request is dangerous. Allow it on its own page.
errors.programs_off: The operator no longer lets programs connect.
errors.client_unknown: This program is not known here. Connect it again from the program.
errors.redirect_invalid: The return address does not belong to this program.
errors.pkce_required: The program does not sign in safely enough (PKCE with S256 is missing).
errors.response_type: The program asks for a sign-in that does not exist here.
errors.resource_invalid: The program asks for access to something other than this app.
errors.ai_not_allowed: The operator does not let your account use AI.
errors.areas_invalid: One of them does not belong to your account.
errors.extra_invalid: There is no such extra here.
errors.mcp_off: The operator has switched MCP access off.

failed: That did not work just now. Try again in a moment.
